Hi
this my first map that i ever made in MTA
i hope you like it

its a EMS station
and have te following items

* the gates are not working if you want the open codes of any door just pm me or ask it in this thread
only what you need to do is make a open/close cmd
  • garage
  • lunch room
  • bedroom
  • exterior
  • vehicles
  • gas station
  • 1 office
  • 1 great office for the firefighters
  • gym room
  • lots more
I Think its good for a roleplay
its located near ls airport on the side of the saint marria beach?
